The 2025-26 Knicks are, BY FAR, the most dominant road team in NBA postseason history. 

New York played 10 road games in 2026. They lost thier first game by one point and then won nine in a row. 

Over those 10 contests, the Knicks outscored their opponents by a total of 175 points. 

+175.
